mapper.select: SELECT id,agent_id,revision,snapshot::text,published_at FROM nw_agent_publications WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND agent_id=#{agentId} AND id=#{revisionId}
SELECT id,agent_id,revision,snapshot::text,published_at FROM nw_agent_publications WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND agent_id=#{agentId} AND revision=#{revision}
SELECT id,revision,snapshot->'agent'->>'name' AS name,published_at FROM nw_agent_publications WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND agent_id=#{agentId} ORDER BY revision DESC

SELECT p.id,p.agent_id,p.revision,p.snapshot::text,p.published_at FROM nw_agent_publications p JOIN nw_agents a ON a.tenant_id=p.tenant_id AND a.id=p.agent_id AND a.published_revision_id=p.id WHERE a.tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND a.status='published' AND a.id IN #{agentId}
